title: LogMessage
description: Canonical log message schema. This is the shared contract between Person 1 (ingestion/producer.py) and Person 2 (consumers/consumer.py). Every message published to the Kafka topic 'logs' MUST conform to this schema. Consumers MUST validate against this schema before processing; non-conforming messages must be routed to the DLQ.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the log event was generated. Example: '2025-01-15T12:34:56.789Z'.

service.description: Name of the originating service or component. Must match one of the known service names defined in ingestion/log_templates.py. Examples: 'auth-service', 'payment-service', 'api-gateway', 'db-proxy'.

severity.description: Log severity level using standard syslog-style labels. Consumers use this field to compute error-rate metrics.

message.description: Human-readable log message body. May contain structured substrings (e.g., key=value pairs) but the field itself is treated as a raw string by the pipeline.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier — 32-character lowercase hex string (UUID v4 without hyphens). Used to correlate log events across services. Generated by the producer; passed through unchanged by consumers and aggregators.

examples.message: Login failed for user_id=42 after 3 attempts
